statement: Each kind of thing is kept in one place
rationale: one place to remember per kind: all the pots in one cabinet, all the snacks in the pantry. A kind split between two cabinets is the one nobody can find

mechanism.how: The kinds in model/inventory.py (plates and bowls, pots, spices, snacks and so on) are each read for the places their things were put; the kinds in more than one place are counted
